description: Airborne radar moving-platform demo. A long-range rotating ARSR rides a MOVING ownship (straight level cruise, no bank needed - radar measures range so the target is fully observable without an observer maneuver, unlike passive IR). Standard GNN tracking, no MSC-RPEKF. Reference pattern: MathWorks 'Multiplatform Radar Detection Generation' (fusionRadarSensor on a waypointTrajectory platform with HasINS).
